title: Secure Coding, Code Review, and Application Verification
learning_outcomes: Explain the main risks and boundaries covered by Secure Coding, Code Review, and Application Verification.
Choose defensive controls appropriate to the Secure Coding, Code Review, and Application Verification topics and document relevant assumptions.
Create or interpret evidence that verifies secure and denied/failure behavior in a controlled environment.
